in_sanskrit.name: Darshiniya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beholder of beauty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Darshiniya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is beheld by the divine beauty of the universe. A name given to the one who is blessed to witness the divine beauty of the universe. Derived from the Sanskrit root word 'darshan' meaning 'to see' and the suffix 'iya' meaning 'one who is beheld'.
